## Who we are

InforBio is a bioinformatics and statistics core facility located at the
Institut de Biologie Paris-Seine, 7-9 Quai St Bernard, 75005 Paris, France.

For any question regarding this policy or your personal data, contact us at:
![](images/email_inforbio.png){width=280px}

## What data we collect

When you use the contact form on this website, we collect:

- your name,
- your email address,
- the content of your message.

We do not collect any other personal data through this form, and this website
does not use advertising or tracking cookies.

## Why we collect it (purpose and legal basis)

The data submitted through the contact form is used **solely to respond to your
request**. The legal basis for this processing is our legitimate interest
(Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) in answering enquiries addressed to us.

Your data is not used for marketing purposes, is not added to any newsletter or
mailing list without your explicit consent, and is never sold or shared with
third parties for their own purposes.

## Who processes the data

Form submissions are handled by **Forminit**, a form-processing service acting
as our data processor. Submissions are stored encrypted on servers located in
the European Union (Ireland), and a data processing agreement (DPA) is in place
in accordance with Article 28 GDPR.

The content of your submission is then delivered by email to the members of the
InforBio team.

## How long we keep it

Form submissions and related email correspondence are kept only as long as
necessary to handle your request, and are deleted at the latest **12 months**
after our last exchange with you.

## Your rights

Under the GDPR (Règlement Général sur la Protection des Données), you have the
right to:

- access the personal data we hold about you,
- ask for it to be corrected or deleted,
- object to or request restriction of its processing,
- lodge a complaint with the French supervisory authority, the
  [CNIL](https://www.cnil.fr).

To exercise any of these rights, write to us at
![](images/email_inforbio.png){width=280px}. We will respond within one month.
